paragraphs: Shimon ben Gurion, Yevamot, end of chapter 6.[^1]

notes.text: Taanit names Nakdimon ben Gurion in the story of borrowing water for the pilgrims. [Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 5:11](https://www.sefaria.org/Jerusalem_Talmud_Ketubot.5.11.3) names Miriam daughter of Shimon ben Gurion, an episode cited by [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3435&lang=en). The corresponding occurrence at Hyman’s Yevamot locator remains unconfirmed.
